title: Finding a Way Through
grammar: Past Conditional (ha + múlt idő + volna) and Unfulfilled Past Obligation (kellett volna)
goal: I can say that we managed to overcome a difficulty, using sikerült.
I can talk about difficulties, obstacles and a way out.
I can say what we should not have done.
